thesis: A late-session 15-minute decline below VWAP that closes in the bottom fifth of its range can earn a short fixed-horizon rebound without path-dependent stop or target exits.
rationale: A training-plus-validation-only diagnostic using nine basis points of round-trip cost found the post-150-minute, below-VWAP, sub-minus-12.5-basis-point return, and sub-0.2 range-position rule positive in both phases with 111 raw observations at a 60-minute horizon. Stops and targets are set to the DSL safety maximum so the event engine tests the fixed-horizon hypothesis directly; 45 and 75 minutes are retained as stability neighbors.
